newsitem.title: JAPAN: Ajinomoto probed for suspected sokaiya link--Kyodo.
newsitem.headline: Ajinomoto probed for suspected sokaiya link--Kyodo.

text.p: Police are investigating Ajinomoto Co Inc on suspicion that it provided money to "sokaiya" racketeers in violation of Japan's commercial law, Kyodo news agency reported on Tuesday.
Ajinomoto, a manufacturer of foodstuffs and seasonings, was not immediately available for comment. Police declined comment on the report.
Kyodo said police were investigating the company and some sokaiya racketeers on suspicion that Ajinomoto paid several million yen to the sokaiya.
Sokaiya extort money from companies by threatening to disturb shareholders' meetings.
